patch_description: Make continuation rollback react to a single substantial exact-objective loss instead of waiting for three checkpoints. A sharp contact surrogate can cross into an inferior contact graph quickly; restoring the exact-best configuration immediately prevents subsequent momentum from reinforcing that transition. After rollback, temporarily reduce the effective sharpness so the optimizer reapproaches the contact boundary with smoother forces, then gradually resumes the scheduled beta. This directly implements a controlled beta retreat while retaining the exact score as the authoritative criterion.
